scope: 11 predefined cases, 3 model attempt(s) per case. Category coverage after pattern checks; not general accuracy or unconstrained inference. Synthetic cases are invented; the Lido case contains recorded public transactions. Near-miss cases test whether evidence checks reject over-claims.

cases.description: Three equal amounts sent to two recipients within two hours.

accepted.title: The same ETH amount went to different addresses
accepted.body: 3 outgoing transfers of exactly 0.1 ETH went to 2 distinct recipients in the fetched window. Equal amounts do not establish shared ownership or payment purpose.
accepted.method: At least two outgoing transfers of exactly the same amount of the same asset (compare asset and baseUnits) to at least two different recipients.
accepted.verification: Pattern checked against fetched records. Payment purpose and ownership remain unknown.

cases.description: An incoming transfer precedes an outgoing transfer by one hour.

accepted.title: An outgoing transfer followed a receipt
accepted.body: A receipt of 0.1 ETH preceded an outgoing transfer of 0.05 ETH by 60 minutes. Timing alone does not show that the same funds moved onward or that these transactions are related.
accepted.method: Exactly two transfers: an incoming transfer followed strictly later by an outgoing transfer within 24 hours. This is temporal order only, not evidence that the received funds were forwarded.
accepted.verification: Pattern checked against fetched records. Payment purpose and ownership remain unknown.
